description: This file is a shell script used to test rename detection in the diff engine, primarily for Git. It sets up various test scenarios, creating files, performing renames and edits, and verifying the output of diff operations involving renames.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a description and a shell command to run.

methods.name: compare_diff_patch
methods.description: Compares the generated diff output to an expected patch format.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks if specific patterns exist within the output.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Generates a file with specified lines.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the Git timer for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of the test script.

calls: test_write_lines line1 line2 line3 line4 line5 line6 line7 line8 line9 line10

git commit -m 'original version of file with no final newline'
